pages.title: Build a playlist
pages.text: Use an image’s gallery … menu to add it to a saved playlist. In Playlists, use the searchable selector and New/Rename/Duplicate/Delete actions. Each slide’s … menu sets duration (1–86400 seconds), moves it or removes it.

pages.title: Choose then play
pages.text: Selecting a saved playlist only changes the editor. Press Play to load it into the shared Screen ID timeline, or this physical display’s local override. Later edits and saved-playlist deletion leave the running snapshot unchanged.

pages.title: Transport and queue
pages.text: Previous/Next navigate slides; Restart restarts the current slide. Pause/Resume retain the offset. Repeat cycles none/list/current; Shuffle uses one server-owned order. Queue Next/Last adds one-off 10-second slides without changing saved playlists.

pages.title: Announcements
pages.text: Announce temporarily displays an image for 10 seconds, then restores the interrupted position and paused state. End it early from the transport … menu. Selecting a static gallery image discards that slideshow.

pages.title: Save and access
pages.text: Offsets, queue and shuffle survive chunk unload and server restart; server downtime does not consume time. Commands and shutdown save immediately; automatic checkpoints run every five seconds. Only your own library can supply slides. Screen control and image-view rules still apply.
